name: Camp Med-O-Lark
description_short: Overnight creative arts camp in Washington, Maine, where campers pick their own activities, from hot glass and fashion design to theater, dance and music. Sessions run 2, 4, 6 or 8 weeks from June 27 to August 21, 2027; 4-week campers can join the musical.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are fully refundable if you change or cancel by March 1, 2027, and tuition paid in full is refundable until then. Half the remaining tuition is due March 1 and the rest May 1. Credit cards carry a 3% fee.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on a lake in Washington, Maine, and tuition includes the waterfront. The pages give no details about swim tests or supervision.

sources.note: Session prices are the regular 2027 rates, multi-session discount included; Winter Savings (deposit by Jan 5, 2027) takes off another $250 per 2 weeks

warnings: Session prices recorded are the regular 2027 rates. Longer sessions already include the multi-session discount (4 weeks drops from $10,400 to $8,400; 6 weeks from $15,600 to $11,600; 8 weeks from $20,800 to $14,800).
Early-enrollment prices are lower if you reserve by Nov 1, 2026, which is about 3 weeks after today: $4,700 for 2 weeks, $7,400 for 4 weeks, $10,100 for 6 weeks and $12,800 for 8 weeks.
Other discounts: $250 off for paying in full in one payment and 10% off for each sibling. Credit cards carry a 3% fee.
The camp says some sessions for some age groups filled up by November last year.

changes: Confirmed all ten 2027 sessions and regular prices ($5,200 for 2 weeks to $14,800 for 8 weeks).
The early discount in the old warning (by Nov 1, 2026) is gone; the page now offers Winter Savings of $250 per 2 weeks for a deposit by January 5, 2027.
Refund summary no longer names a deposit amount: the page says $750 per 2 weeks in one place and $1,000 in the FAQ. Both say full refund by March 1, 2027.
Added age_min 7. Left age_max blank: the homepage says ages 7-17 in one line and 7-16 in another.
Registration link now goes to the camper application, and the activity list comes from the activities page.
